# Build a Simple Bioconductor Container

If you would like to create a new container with a set of packages and
some data or scripts, and be able to easily share it with other users
through [docker hub](https://hub.docker.com/) or the [Github container
registry](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-github-container-registry/),
this package might be useful.

This package was developed as part of the [EuroBioc
2026](https://eurobioc2026.bioconductor.org/)
[hackathon](https://github.com/BiocCodingCollaborations/EuroBioc2026_Hackathon).

A citable BioHackrXiv preprint is also available
([DOI:10.37044/osf.io/acxky_v1](https://doi.org/10.37044/osf.io/acxky_v1)).

- [`makeSimpleBiocContainer()`](https://lgatto.github.io/SimpleBiocContainer/reference/makeSimpleBiocContainer.md)
  : Create a Simple Bioconductor Container
